items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...This is Bill Russell doing the interviewing.

ctx.x: L-E-U. And the date is the 18th of October 1961. This is Bill Russell doing the interviewing. Do you mind telling just where you were born and when you were born, your birthday, when it is?
I was born in 1896. 1896. In St. Charles Parish. St. Charles, is that up the river? It's about 40 miles from here. What was the exact birthday? When is your birthday?
